home_prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one original polished Japanese coffee shop homepage proposal image, wide 16:9. Company exact text『自家焙煎 珈琲屋チャペック』. Main improvement: responsive mobile layout, all menu items and contact information fit inside screen with no horizontal overflow. Compose a large desktop homepage on left and clearly readable mobile version on right, flat presentation on ivory background, restrained brown and muted moss green, generous margins. Original illustrative coffee cup and beans photo, not actual shop. Desktop navigation『ホーム』『珈琲のご案内』『店舗案内』『お問い合わせ』; headline『自家焙煎の珈琲を、日々の一杯に。』; subtext『石川県金沢市の珈琲屋チャペック』. Button『珈琲のご案内』. Contact panel exact『石川県金沢市西都1-217』『076-266-3133』『capek85@nifty.com』. Mobile: company name wraps neatly, menu in two rows, coffee image, contact details vertically stacked at readable size fully within mobile boundary. No booking, no shopping cart, no invented form, no prices/hours/awards/testimonials, no borrowed logos or mascot or photography. Clearly visible overall caption『非公式デザイン案｜写真はイメージです』. Natural accurate readable Japanese, professional web design, balanced responsive demonstration.
inquiry_prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a separate original 16:9 inquiry/contact page proposal for『自家焙煎 珈琲屋チャペック』. Reference image is STYLE reference only: preserve ivory/brown/moss green palette, elegant readable Japanese typography and left desktop plus right mobile composition. This is CONTACT page now, not homepage. Improvement: existing email/phone contact details fit vertically at 390px with no horizontal overflow. Exact header『自家焙煎 珈琲屋チャペック』 navigation『ホーム』『珈琲のご案内』『店舗案内』『お問い合わせ』. Main title『お問い合わせ』. Prominent stacked two panels:『メールでのお問い合わせ』『capek85@nifty.com』『メールを作成する』 and『お電話でのお問い合わせ』『076-266-3133』. Lower address『店舗案内』『石川県金沢市西都1-217』. Phone mobile shows full company name wrapped, compact 2x2 navigation and same two contact panels vertically, each complete and readable. Small original illustrative coffee beans/cup image only. Do not add a contact form, input fields, submission/confirmation, reservation, response-time promises, new services, hours, pricing or copied logo/mascot. Text and contact data exact. Visible footer『非公式デザイン案｜写真はイメージです』. Large margins and strong legibility.
recovery_note: 3ページの390px・1280px画像6点を再取得。フレームURLをDOMで確認し、珈琲案内と店舗案内は本文URLを直接表示して保存。contactファイルは店舗案内・営業情報であり、連絡先はトップに掲載。
